caption: A clear glass jar of water is held in front of a printed face on a poster, and the eyes seen through the jar look stretched wide.

sa.check: A printed face is on a poster.
A clear glass jar of water is held in front of it.
The eyes seen through the jar look stretched wide.
The face beside the jar is normal.
The stretch changes as the jar moves.

pc.expect: The stretching appears only in the part of the face seen through the water and changes as the jar moves.
pc.fail: The face is stretched beside the jar; or unchanged through it; or the stretch stays fixed as the jar moves.

pc.expect: The poster is unchanged; the stretch is an appearance.
pc.fail: The poster bends; or the printed face changes; or a different face appears.

pc.expect: The jar is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The jar warps; or the water tilts and holds; or goes opaque.

pc.expect: The jar moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It floats; or slides; or jumps.
The jar duplicates; or the poster vanishes; or the jar passes through the poster.

pc.expect: The poster's colours and the jar stay the same.
pc.fail: The poster changes colour; or the jar changes shape; or the wall changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
